name: genesis-conductor-rule30-vdf
description: Rule30 VDF — Rule 30 based Verifiable Delay Function cryptographic research implementation by Igor Holt (@invariantx) for Genesis Conductor thermodynamic computing stack. Cellular automata VDF providing temporal verification primitives, cryptographic proof, and energy-grounded timing for autonomous agent orchestration. Integrated with Genesis Conductor for verifiable compute, provenance sovereignty, and thermodynamic determinism patterns. Composes with OpenClaw skills, diamondNode attestation, and persistent state for long-horizon reliable agent execution and A2A coordination.
